title: Slack lane: bbox_context/bbox_messages drill-downs recommended by search output fail on slack: virtual paths
wanted_capability: Reading the surrounding conversation for a Slack search hit. bbox_search results advertise the standard next steps, but both fail on the slack lane: bbox_context(file_path="slack:T4MNK2L6A/C0BP8JG21FU") errors with "No such file or directory" (the virtual slack: path is handed to the filesystem transcript reader), and bbox_messages(session_id="C0BP8JG21FU/2026-08-10") returns "Session not found" while bbox_messages(file_path=...) returns 1-of-1 with the same ENOENT rendered inline. Wanted: the slack read plane wired into the context/messages surfaces (resolve slack: refs against the conversation-source landing store instead of the filesystem), and the rendered next-steps hints suppressed or corrected for lanes that cannot serve them.
missing_primitive: slack:-scheme resolution in the bbox_context / bbox_messages read plane
fallback_used: Read the channel's docs via fulltext file_path:"slack:T4MNK2L6A/<channel-id>" search hits and their permalinks; ground truth via read-only conversations.history with the collector's token chain.
evidence: live probe 2026-08-14: bbox_context ENOENT and bbox_messages Session-not-found on hits the search surface itself recommended
notes: PARTIAL (same-day): the misleading breadcrumb half is fixed; Slack top hits now recommend the working drill-downs (bbox_search channel filter + per-hit permalink) instead of bbox_context/bbox_messages, and the tool-doc stanzas for both read tools state the transcript-file-only boundary. REMAINING: the actual read-plane port, resolving slack: locators against the conversation-source landing store so bbox_context/bbox_messages can serve a channel's surrounding turns natively.
